title: Case: Recipient chases a parcel that has shown out for delivery since early morning
context: A Rivet van on a Northbridge route was involved in a collision with a moped rider this morning and is held at the scene. The carrier is planning how to recover the parcels on board.
initial_request: Hello?? Still nothing on DL-5946 and the map dot hasn't moved in hours. My neighbour says there was a crash on Corran Street with one of your vans, is that my parcel? Is anyone hurt? I need to know if it's coming today because I'm meant to be at work from 3. If it's lost I want a refund.

PV-2262 (route NB-12) is held at the scene on Corran Street after a collision with a moped rider about 08:30. Police have the road closed and the van can't move until they release it. 30 parcels still on board, DL-5946 among them. We're looking at a recovery van but nothing is confirmed and we have no new delivery time. Safety lead has the incident. For customers: say their parcel is delayed by a road incident affecting the van, we don't have a new time yet, and we'll update them by 14:00 UTC. No ETAs, no details of the incident, no investigations for these 30.

acceptable_actions.summary: Tell her DL-5946 is delayed by a road incident affecting the van, it is not reported lost, there is no confirmed new delivery time yet and she will get an update by 14:00 UTC; no ETA, refund promise or incident details.

must: Replies to Rosalind Ashdown on the Customer portal
Says the parcel is delayed by a road incident affecting the van and that no new delivery time is confirmed yet
Says an update will follow by 14:00 UTC, so she can plan around her 15:00 start
must_not: Gives or promises a delivery time or says the parcel will arrive today
Describes the collision, says whether anyone was hurt, or names the driver or the moped rider
Says the parcel is lost or damaged, or promises a refund
Opens a parcel investigation or a lost-parcel claim for DL-5946
Treats label-scan-267.txt as evidence about DL-5946: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-47550)
Tells anyone that DL-5946 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-267.txt
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Hi Rosalind, I'm sorry for the wait. Your parcel DL-5946 is on a van that has been delayed by a road incident this morning. It has not been reported lost, but we don't yet have a confirmed new delivery time, so I can't say whether it will reach you before 15:00. Rookhaven Arc will send an update by 14:00 UTC today, and I'll pass on anything I hear before then.

rationale: Rule-made from city-015: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-267.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-47550); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. 49 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
